individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows bright-field and fluorescence photographs of whole lungs, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar graph of ICG mean fluorescence intensity shows individual mouse data points (blue and red dots) overlaid on the bars for both No Cre and Adeno Cre groups.
The Cd68 and Spp1 panels are spatial expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue sections, not averaged bar/line data requiring individual points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual data points is not applicable/would be unreadable, so this is exempt.

Bars represent log2 fold-change values per gene derived from Seurat differential expression statistics (Wilcoxon test across many spots), not means of a small number of biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable here.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a plot of averaged quantitative data.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A contains only photographs, no plotted statistics.
PASS - error bars are explicitly defined in the caption as mean ± SD.
not needed - Panel C shows histology, fluorescence images and spatial expression heatmaps with no error bars.
not needed - GSEA enrichment plots display a single enrichment score curve per gene set with no error bars; NES/FDR/p values are reported instead of variability measures.
not needed - Bar graph shows single log2 fold-change values per gene with associated p values, but no error bars are drawn on the bars.
not needed - Panel F contains representative images only, no plotted statistics with error bars.
